perdomo--perdomo-reserve-10th-anniversar.description: Perdomo's Reserve 10th Anniversary Champagne sets an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler aged at least six years; it is the line where the house first rested wrappers in bourbon barrels. The smoke is soft and creamy, with honey, cashew-like nuttiness, cedar and a light pepper edge, a calm choice for the morning or early afternoon.

thirds.notes: Lightly sweet cashew and cream open the cigar, with a pinch of pepper on a long finish.
The profile shifts to nutty wood and eases in body, pepper still in the background.
Little changes to the end; cedar and cream on the finish keep it even and smooth.

sources.title: Perdomo – Reserve 10th Anniversary
Mike's Cigars – Perdomo Reserve 10th Anniversary Champagne
Cigar Obsession – Perdomo Reserve 10th Anniv. Champagne Epicure review

perdomo--perdomo-reserve-10th-anniversar.description: The Sun Grown edition of Perdomo's Reserve 10th Anniversary is a Nicaraguan puro: a six-year-old Cuban-seed sun-grown wrapper, rested ten months in bourbon barrels, over aged Cuban-seed binder and filler. It smokes earthy and gently sweet, with spice through the middle and a finish of oak and almond, at a fuller pace than the Champagne.

sources.title: Perdomo – Reserve 10th Anniversary
Cigar Coop – Perdomo Reserve 10th Anniversary Box-Pressed Sun Grown Epicure review

thirds.notes: Earth and wood come forward, with nuts, baking spice and a fruity tobacco sweetness; pepper at the back of the throat.
Earth and wood stay in front as pepper grows on the tongue; the nuts disappear.
Pepper moves up beside earth and wood, with a little baking spice and sweetness left.

perdomo--perdomo-reserve-10th-anniversar.description: Perdomo's Reserve 10th Anniversary Maduro is a Nicaraguan puro whose six-year-old Cuban-seed maduro wrapper spends fourteen months in bourbon barrels before it is rolled over aged Cuban-seed binder and filler. Natural sweetness leads and deepens into dark chocolate and espresso on the finish, a dense smoke for after dinner.

sources.title: Perdomo – Reserve 10th Anniversary
Cigar Coop – Perdomo Reserve 10th Anniversary Box-Pressed Maduro Robusto review

thirds.notes: Mocha leads and then separates into espresso and chocolate, over oak, cedar, mineral and a little citrus.
Espresso holds the front; red pepper appears on the tongue as the citrus sweetness fades.
Espresso remains the core, with more pepper and oak, cedar and traces of chocolate.

perdomo--perdomo-20th-anniversary-connec.description: For its 20th Anniversary range, Perdomo wraps higher-priming Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler in an Ecuadorian Connecticut leaf aged eight years and then given eight more months in bourbon barrels. The smoke is creamy and rounded, closing on honey and soft spice, an easy companion for the first coffee of the day.

sources.title: Perdomo – 20th Anniversary

perdomo--perdomo-20th-anniversary-sun-gr.description: The 20th Anniversary Sun Grown is a Nicaraguan puro: a Cuban-seed sun-grown wrapper aged eight years and finished ten months in bourbon barrels, over higher-priming Nicaraguan binder and filler. It smokes woody and earthy, with fragrant wood, nutmeg and coffee over oak and cedar, and a black pepper that only arrives near the end.

thirds.notes: Fragrant wood leads, with nutmeg and a bright citrus note and almost no heat.
Oak takes over, joined by a resinous, leathery edge and coffee grounds on the retrohale.
Oak and coffee carry on to the nub while black pepper appears, mostly through the nose.

sources.title: Perdomo – 20th Anniversary
Bespoke Unit – Perdomo 20th Anniversary Sun Grown review

perdomo--perdomo-20th-anniversary-maduro.description: Perdomo's 20th Anniversary Maduro is a Nicaraguan puro: an eight-year-old Cuban-seed maduro wrapper given fourteen extra months in bourbon barrels, over higher-priming Nicaraguan binder and filler. The smoke is rich and layered, finishing on chocolate and espresso, and sits well beside a glass of red wine after dinner.

sources.title: Perdomo – 20th Anniversary
Cigar Coop – Perdomo 20th Anniversary Maduro review

thirds.notes: Leather from the cold draw carries into the start, then an exotic spice and unsweetened cocoa take over.
Cocoa and spice balance each other in front, with leather behind.
Nutty notes join the cocoa before the spice takes control, and the body turns fuller.

perdomo--perdomo-30th-anniversary-connec.description: Named for Perdomo's thirtieth year, this blend uses fifteen-year-old tobacco throughout: an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper rested in bourbon barrels over Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler. It is soft and creamy, with honey on the palate and a light oak note in the finish, well matched to a cappuccino in the morning.

sources.title: Perdomo – 30th Anniversary
Cigar Coop – Perdomo 30th Anniversary Connecticut Epicure review

thirds.notes: Cedar, cream, earth, berry and chestnut, with cream and earth moving forward and black pepper on the retrohale.
Cream and earth stay in front with cedar; the berry note fades and the cream lasts well.
Cedar and earth take the lead, with cream still present and a little chestnut and pepper.

perdomo--perdomo-30th-anniversary-sun-gr.description: The 30th Anniversary Sun Grown is a Nicaraguan puro built from fifteen-year-old Cuban-seed tobacco, its sun-grown wrapper aged in bourbon barrels before rolling. A gentle spice from the wrapper runs over a rich base, and the finish settles into smooth oak and cedar; a measured, medium-to-full smoke for a whisky in the evening.

sources.title: Perdomo – 30th Anniversary
Cigar Coop – Perdomo 30th Anniversary Sun Grown Epicure review

thirds.notes: Natural tobacco, oak and a sweet cinnamon-like heat give way to earth and milk chocolate, with chili and black pepper.
Milk chocolate and earth dominate while the pepper slowly builds.
Oak and earth take over, with milk chocolate and pepper that rises without becoming sharp.

perdomo--perdomo-30th-anniversary-maduro.description: Perdomo's 30th Anniversary Maduro rolls fifteen-year-old Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler in a bourbon barrel-aged maduro wrapper of the same age. Bold and sweet, it moves from cracked pepper to hazelnut and dark chocolate, then closes on almond, raisin and coffee, a full-bodied smoke for the evening.

thirds.notes: Black pepper opens, then yields to chocolate and hazelnut with a hint of vanilla.
The pepper softens into hazelnut and dark chocolate, with a faint salty edge.
Sweetness builds as almond leads, with raisin and a coffee-toned finish.

sources.title: Perdomo – 30th Anniversary
Bespoke Unit – Perdomo 30th Anniversary Maduro review

perdomo--perdomo-double-aged-12-year-vin.description: Perdomo's Double Aged 12 Year Vintage takes tobacco bale-aged for ten years and rests every leaf two more years in charred white-oak bourbon barrels. This version wears an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler, and smokes creamy and buttery, with caramel-like sweetness and cedar.

sources.title: Perdomo – Double Aged 12 Year Vintage
Cigar Coop – Perdomo Double Aged 12 Year Vintage Connecticut Robusto review

thirds.notes: Cedar and orange lead over cream, with a soft black pepper on the finish and a sweet-spiced cedar retrohale.
The orange turns into a nougat-like sweetness with citrus; cedar comes and goes as the cream recedes.
Nougat sweetness and cedar carry the finish, with pepper rising gently at the end.

perdomo--perdomo-double-aged-12-year-vin.description: The Sun Grown Double Aged 12 Year Vintage is a Nicaraguan puro whose tobacco is bale-aged ten years, then kept two years in charred bourbon barrels, all under a sun-grown wrapper. Earthy with a spicy sweetness, it brings oak, almond and a brandy-like warmth, ending long and warm.

thirds.notes: A brandy-like sweetness with almond behind it, and a firm oak note on the finish.
Almond moves to the front with gentle sweetness and light spice as the brandy note fades.
Oak dominates the close, with a touch of cinnamon and a little almond sweetness.

sources.title: Perdomo – Double Aged 12 Year Vintage
The Cigar Authority – Perdomo Double Aged Sun Grown review

perdomo--perdomo-double-aged-12-year-vin.description: In the Maduro Double Aged 12 Year Vintage, a Cuban-seed Nicaraguan maduro wrapper joins Cuban-seed binder and filler, each leaf bale-aged ten years and then barrel-aged two more in charred bourbon casks. The result is smooth and naturally sweet around a robust core, with a finish of dark chocolate and coffee.

sources.title: Perdomo – Double Aged 12 Year Vintage
Cigar Coop – Perdomo Double Aged 12-Year Vintage Maduro Churchill review

thirds.notes: Creamy cocoa comes forward early, with cedar, earth, pepper and a fruity tobacco sweetness behind.
Coffee rises to the front and earth joins it, while the cocoa loses its creaminess.
Earth edges past coffee; pepper and cedar grow but stay in support.

perdomo--perdomo-habano-bourbon-barrel-a.description: Part of Perdomo's Habano Bourbon Barrel-Aged series, in which the wrappers are rested in bourbon barrels, this version pairs an Ecuadorian Connecticut leaf with Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler from the family farms around Estelí, Condega and Jalapa. It is the mildest of the three wrapper shades in the series.

sources.title: Perdomo – Habano Bourbon Barrel-Aged
Cigars Direct – Perdomo Habano Bourbon Barrel Aged
The Cigar Authority – Perdomo Habano Bourbon Barrel Aged Connecticut review

thirds.notes: An almond-like sweetness trades places with cedar, over a smooth, bourbon-tinged finish.
The bourbon character grows as the almond fades; earth and cedar emerge with spice in the nose.
Earth takes the lead and the bourbon moves into a long, buttery finish with more spice.

perdomo--perdomo-habano-bourbon-barrel-a.description: The Sun Grown member of Perdomo's Habano Bourbon Barrel-Aged series rolls Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler, grown on the family farms around Estelí, Condega and Jalapa, in a Nicaraguan sun-grown wrapper rested in bourbon barrels. It sits between the Connecticut and the Maduro, at a medium-to-full strength.

sources.title: Perdomo – Habano Bourbon Barrel-Aged
Cigars Direct – Perdomo Habano Bourbon Barrel Aged
The Cigar Authority – Perdomo Habano Barrel Aged Sun Grown review

thirds.notes: Maple and walnut open the smoke, with a bourbon-like finish and spice through the nose.
The bourbon notes grow, nuttiness leads on the palate and a gentle sweetness appears.
Chocolate becomes the main note and the finish turns to espresso, with the barrel clearest on the retrohale.

perdomo--perdomo-habano-bourbon-barrel-a.description: The Maduro of Perdomo's Habano Bourbon Barrel-Aged series uses Cuban-seed tobacco from the family farms, seco from Condega, viso from Jalapa and ligero from Estelí, aged four to six years, with the maduro wrapper given fourteen months in bourbon barrels. Sweet and woody rather than boozy, it shows oak, chocolate, earth and coffee.

thirds.notes: Marked sweetness and faint oak open, with chocolate, earth, coffee and red pepper through the nose.
The sweetness eases while oak and coffee trade places, with more red pepper on the retrohale.
Oak stays, chocolate sweetness returns on the finish and the retrohale turns earthy.

sources.title: Cigars Direct – Perdomo Habano Bourbon Barrel Aged Maduro
The Cigar Authority – Perdomo Bourbon Barrel Aged Maduro Epicure review

perdomo--perdomo-lot-23-connecticut.description: Lot 23 goes back to a project Nick Perdomo Sr. began in 2000, built on bale-aged tobacco from the 2001 harvest. The Connecticut version wraps five-year-aged Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler in a higher-priming Ecuadorian Connecticut-shade leaf, giving a smooth, creamy smoke with cedar and honey on the finish.

sources.title: Perdomo – Lot 23
Gotham Cigars – Perdomo Lot 23 Connecticut review

thirds.notes: Sweet wood, mocha and roasted nuts, with honey, a flicker of citrus, coffee and cream on the finish.
A smoky, charred note spreads through coffee, wood and salted nuts, joined by caramel and dry leather.
The sweetness fades, leaving smoky dried leaves, earth, leather and roasted nuts.

perdomo--perdomo-lot-23-sun-grown.description: Lot 23 grew from a project Nick Perdomo Sr. started in 2000 around bale-aged tobacco. The Sun Grown version uses a five-year-aged, higher-priming Nicaraguan sun-grown wrapper over Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler of the same age; medium-bodied, rich and earthy, it ends on almond and cedar.

sources.title: Perdomo – Lot 23
JR Cigar Blending Room – Perdomo Lot 23 review

thirds.notes: A sharp pepper start that soon settles behind coffee, cedar and roasted nuts.
The same four notes hold steady, with an even burn and an easy draw.
A brief burst of pepper, then coffee, cedar and nuts carry on unchanged to the end.

perdomo--perdomo-lot-23-maduro.description: The Maduro edition of Lot 23, a line rooted in a bale-aging project Nick Perdomo Sr. began in 2000, rolls five-year-aged Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler in a higher-priming Nicaraguan maduro wrapper of the same age. Rich and sweet, it finishes on oak and espresso, a medium-to-full smoke for the evening.

sources.title: Perdomo – Lot 23
Cigar Coop – Perdomo Lot 23 Maduro Toro review

thirds.notes: Cocoa leads over cedar, dried fruit, oak and white pepper, with coffee joining for a mocha-like moment.
Coffee replaces cocoa in front, and pepper and cedar grow.
Pepper and cedar come up beside the coffee, with fruit, oak and cocoa in the background.

perdomo--perdomo-inmenso-seventy-sun-gro.description: Inmenso Seventy is Perdomo's large-ring line, with every size at a 70 ring gauge. The Sun Grown version wraps five-year-aged Nicaraguan long filler in a Cuban-seed Nicaraguan sun-grown leaf, and the wide format gives a cool, creamy, medium-bodied smoke of cedar, earth and spice.

sources.title: Holt's – Perdomo Inmenso Seventy Sun Grown

perdomo--perdomo-inmenso-seventy-maduro.description: The Maduro edition of Perdomo's Inmenso Seventy, every size at a 70 ring gauge, uses a five-year-aged Cuban-seed Nicaraguan maduro wrapper over binder and filler of the same age. Creamy and mellow at first, it settles into earth, nuts and wood and gathers body toward the end without turning harsh.

thirds.notes: Earthy and lightly sweet, with nuts and spice in front and hints of leather, oak and raisin.
Earth, nuts and wood settle in, with less sweetness and a smooth, steady body.
The profile holds and stays creamy while the body moves toward full.

sources.title: Holt's – Perdomo Inmenso Seventy
Famous Smoke Cigar Advisor – Perdomo Inmenso Seventy Maduro review

perdomo--perdomo-fresco-connecticut.description: Perdomo Fresco is the house's bundle line, offered in four sizes from Robusto to Churchill. The Connecticut version pairs an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper with Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler; it is rich and creamy at a mild-to-medium pace, with oak and cedar on the finish, an uncomplicated daily smoke.

sources.title: Perdomo – Fresco
Gotham Cigars – Perdomo Fresco review

thirds.notes: Cedar with sweet undertones, licorice and a light nuttiness, turning creamier towards the middle.
Rich cream grows, the nuts deepen and pepper moves from the background to the front.
Pepper dominates as the cream fades, with a hint of toast and a return of oak and cedar.

perdomo--perdomo-fresco-sun-grown.description: The Sun Grown member of Perdomo's Fresco bundle line wraps Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler in a Nicaraguan sun-grown leaf. It smokes rich and spicy, with an oak and almond finish, at a medium-to-full strength; a straightforward everyday cigar in Robusto, Toro, Torpedo and Churchill sizes.

sources.title: Perdomo – Fresco

perdomo--perdomo-fresco-maduro.description: The Maduro of Perdomo's Fresco bundle line rolls Cuban-seed Nicaraguan binder and filler in a dark Nicaraguan maduro wrapper. Rich and sweet, it ends on chocolate and coffee, a medium-to-full everyday smoke offered in Robusto, Toro, Torpedo and Churchill sizes.

sources.title: Perdomo – Fresco

perdomo--perdomo-legacy-ecuadorian-conne.description: Legacy is the first blend led by Nicholas Perdomo III, developed over five years and released in 2025. This version uses a ten-year-aged Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper given at least eight months in bourbon barrels, over a Nicaraguan shade-grown binder and filler from Estelí, Condega and Jalapa. Creamy and bready, it gathers nutty, toffee-like sweetness as it burns.

thirds.notes: Vanilla, almond and cedar open over light wood, with a restrained black pepper.
The pepper softens to gentle spice as praline, hazelnut and caramelised sugar join a bready core.
Earth, wood and roasted nuts rise with coffee and toffee, ending on a light floral touch.

sources.title: Perdomo – Legacy
The Cigar Authority – Perdomo Legacy Connecticut Epicure review

perdomo--perdomo-legacy-nicaraguan-shade.description: In Perdomo's Legacy line, released in 2025, this version wraps Cuban-seed binder and filler in a reddish shade-grown leaf from a Cuban and Cameroon hybrid seed, grown at Finca Natalie in Estelí, bale-aged ten years and rested at least ten months in bourbon barrels. It is layered and medium to full, with vanilla, leather, citrus and a sweet oak finish.

thirds.notes: Vanilla and dark cherry recall an Old Fashioned, with nutmeg, cinnamon, leather and black pepper.
A brighter floral and citrus turn, with honey and clove; the leather holds and the pepper softens.
Molasses and toasted bread lead into charred oak, nutty leather and a coffee close as strength rises.

sources.title: Perdomo – Legacy
The Cigar Authority – Perdomo Legacy Nicaraguan Shade Grown Churchill review

perdomo--perdomo-legacy-maduro.description: The Maduro in Perdomo's Legacy line, released in 2025, uses a ten-year-aged Cuban-seed maduro wrapper rested at least fourteen months in bourbon barrels, over a Nicaraguan shade-grown binder and filler from Estelí, Condega and Jalapa. Earthy and cocoa-rich, it builds steadily through leather, cedar and roasted coffee.

thirds.notes: Brief pepper gives way to damp earth and dry cocoa, with cinnamon, dark chocolate and leather.
Richer now: chocolate and raisin sweetness over mineral earth, dry leather, cedar and light coffee.
Leather, cedar and fresh earth hold to the end, with black pepper, cocoa and roasted coffee.

sources.title: Perdomo – Legacy
The Cigar Authority – Perdomo Legacy Maduro Epicure review
